results.heading: Cancellation policy
results.text: Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled free of charge up to 24 hours before the appointment time. Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice, and missed appointments, are charged ₺500.

results.heading: How to cancel
results.text: Reply to your confirmation email or call reception. Cancellations by email are confirmed by a member of staff; they are not automatic.

results.heading: Insurance
results.text: We work with Allianz, AXA and Anadolu Sigorta private health policies. Bring your policy number; we check coverage before treatment and bill the insurer directly where the policy allows it.

args.subject: Re: Sick - need to cancel and rebook
args.body:
Dear Erdemer,

I'm sorry to hear you're unwell, and please don't worry about the notice. Your appointment tomorrow (Tue 20 October, 14:30) has been passed to our reception team, who will confirm the cancellation and help you rebook for around 3 November.

Please note our policy: cancellations made with less than 24 hours' notice are charged ₺500 (see our cancellation policy). A member of staff will review this with you.

Please rest and take care. Get well soon.

Warm regards,
Nova Dental Clinic reception
